subject: Annotation options how to place p-values on a plot?

messages.author: 409dfe1554e9c224
messages.subject: Annotation options how to place p-values on a plot?
parts:
Hi (again),

Has anybody come up with an elegant, automated way of adding a t-test
(Mann-Whitney) p value to a density plot? I'm looking for something
like a symbol-less entry in the legend or any other margin position.
Custom annotation really seems difficult in ggplot2 ...

Joh

use to that placing, but any easy to use on-plot annotation that can be
integrated directly int a qplot object would be better ...

Joh
